one_line: Global AI developments span corporate restructuring, infrastructure investments, regulatory battles over exports and agent control, and new model launches.

themes.title: AI workforce impacts and job displacement
themes.text: SAP announced plans to eliminate at least 10,000 positions for its AI shift, while a JP Morgan report estimates that AI could displace 24 million knowledge-worker jobs over five years.

stories.headline: SAP prepares plan to eliminate at least 10,000 positions for AI shift
AI could displace 24 million knowledge-worker jobs in five years: JP Morgan

themes.title: Export controls impact global chip sales
themes.text: The Dutch government is seeking to block the US MATCH Act restricting ASML sales in China, as ASML's CEO warns export controls will accelerate domestic Chinese technology development. Meanwhile, US computing restrictions and anti-distillation measures caused Z.ai to miss its GLM-5.5 launch.

stories.headline: Netherlands seeks to block US MATCH Act restricting ASML China sales
ASML CEO warns aggressive export controls will push China to build domestic tech
Z.ai misses GLM-5.5 launch as US rules and distillation curbs hit China AI

themes.title: Data centre infrastructure and power expansion
themes.text: JERA is in talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres near Tokyo, and Texas approved permits for SpaceX's gas power plant to support data center infrastructure. Additionally, Avicena raised over $100 million for microLED optical interconnects, and Bharti Airtel announced a ₹1,200 crore investment in Assam data centres.

stories.headline: Japan's JERA enters talks with Anthropic and Meta to build data centres
Avicena raises $100M+ Series C for microLED optical interconnects
Texas resumes data center permitting and approves SpaceX gas plant
Bharti Airtel to invest ₹1,200 crore in three Assam data centres

themes.title: Regulation and oversight of AI agents
themes.text: The UK Competition and Markets Authority warned that personal AI agents must provide user control over data access, following Meta's launch of its Muse agent. Concurrently, Dante Security raised $10 million to offer a platform for monitoring enterprise AI agents.

stories.headline: UK regulator warns AI agents must provide user control as Meta Muse launches
Dante Security raises $10M seed to monitor enterprise AI agents
